ChangeRequest.title: ChangeRequest
ChangeRequest.description: A suggestion, addition, or change request submitted by a Quadra 12 visitor or student for review by the creator.

authorUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the submitting user.

authorName.description: Display name of the submitting user.

targetSection.description: Quadra 12 tab or section the suggestion applies to.

title.description: Short summary of the addition or change.

details.description: Detailed description of what should be added or changed.

status.description: Review lifecycle status controlled by the creator.

creatorNote.description: Optional response note from the creator.

/changeRequests/{requestId}.description: Stores community additions and change requests readable by their author or the Quadra 12 creator admin.
